chunks: al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from Muhammad b. Sinan. He said: Abu'l-Jarud Ziyad b. al-Mundhir narrated to us from Sa'id b. Jubayr from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:

The wilaya of Ali b. Abi Talib is the wilaya of God. Loving him is the worship of God. Obeying him is obligated by God. His friends are the friends of God, his enemies are the enemies of God, his war is God's war, and his peace is the peace of God, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.عبادة: Worship — devotion to God; here equated with loving Ali
key_terms.فريضة: Divine obligation — a mandatory duty imposed by God
key_terms.ولاية: Wilaya — spiritual and political authority, guardianship, and sovereignty

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the authority (wilaya) of Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition establishes the cosmic significance of Imam Ali's authority, declaring his wilaya to be identical with divine authority, his love to be an act of worship, and his obedience a divine obligation. The Prophet further states that Ali's allies and enemies are God's allies and enemies, and that war or peace with Ali is equivalent to war or peace with God. Narrated through Ibn Abbas, this was proclaimed publicly to define Ali's metaphysical rank.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him
